$comment: Old address -> new address. THE source of truth for redirects; docs/REDIRECTS.md and docs/redirects.csv are made from it. Edit this file, then run `pnpm redirects:csv` and `pnpm redirects:check`. Fields: from (old path, on team6220.org), to (new path, may end in #anchor), status (301 for the Wix URL Redirect Manager), decision (confirmed = already agreed in REDIRECTS.md; owner = decided by the owner; proposed = suggested in SEO.md or chosen as nearest page, needs a yes), note. `anchors` are the prototype's one-page addresses (dev.team6220.org/#about): browsers never send the # part to a server, so they cannot be Wix redirects. A script on the home page (MainLayout.astro, map in sites/main/data/old-anchors.ts) sends them; they are listed here so the map is checked against the built site and kept equal to old-anchors.ts.

pages.note: The page always exists; it shows in the menu only while the summer camp switch is on.
No subteams page yet. Change this if one is added.

Owner decision: Contact (under About) has no page of its own; it scrolls to the footer. The footer's id is `contact` (sites/main/components/Footer.astro), so the target is /#contact. This replaces the earlier /about/contact in REDIRECTS.md. While /about/contact still exists, the home page script maps #contact to it (see anchors below); remove `contact` from sites/main/data/old-anchors.ts when that page is removed, or this redirect lands on /about/contact. If Wix's redirect manager refuses a # in the new address, use / instead.
Wix page named APPLY, same content as /contact. SEO.md suggested /about/contact; the owner decision for Contact (footer) applies. See /contact.
SEO.md names no target (one-off page of yearbook photo captions, in the old sitemap). Nearest page: Media.
